project.name: Tailzyai
project.description: A playful, warm, and inviting pet care SaaS with AI Copilot.

theme.strategy: The 'Sunset Walk' Palette - Warm, organic, and energetic.

primary.name: Coral Pop
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, Active States, Brand Highlights

secondary.name: Fresh Mint
secondary.usage: Health metrics, Success states, Secondary buttons

typography.instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;500;700&family=Nunito:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');

inputs.style: rounded-2xl border-2 border-orange-100 bg-white/50 focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 transition-all h-12 px-4

navigation.style: Floating dock or pill-shaped header. Glassmorphism with warm tint (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md).

copilot_page.structure: Split view or Floating Drawer. Chat interface is central.
copilot_page.details: User messages in Primary Color bubbles. AI messages in White bubbles with soft shadow. Use 'typing' animations (bouncing dots). Context sidebar shows relevant pet data dynamically.

home_page.details: Hero: 'Daily Snapshot' (Large card with Pet Photo + Today's mood). Side: 'Quick Actions' (Add Activity, Log Food). Bottom: 'Health Trends' (Wavy charts).

profile_page.details: Playful avatar uploader. Subscription plan as 'Treat Jars' or 'Tickets'.

decorations: Organic blobs in background (absolute positioned, -z-10, opacity-50)
Dotted grid overlays in specific sections

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE tailwind.config.js with the new colors and border radius.
UPDATE index.css with the Google Fonts import.
CREATE a 'Layout' component that wraps pages with the 'Warm Bone' background and organic blobs.
USE 'lucide-react' for icons (PawPrint, Bone, Activity, Heart, MessageCircle).
ENSURE the Copilot chat feels like a messaging app (WhatsApp/iMessage) but branded.
DO NOT use default Shadcn 'slate' colors. Override them with the Warm Charcoal and Sand palette.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
